ayahs.arabic_text: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ هَلْ أَتَىٰ عَلَى ٱلْإِنسَٰنِ حِينٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلدَّهْرِ لَمْ يَكُن شَيْـًۭٔا مَّذْكُورًا
ayahs.english_translation: HAS THERE [not] been an endless span of time before man [appeared - a time] when he was not yet a thing to be thought of?

ayahs.arabic_text: إِنَّا خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ أَمْشَاجٍۢ نَّبْتَلِيهِ فَجَعَلْنَٰهُ سَمِيعًۢا بَصِيرًا
ayahs.english_translation: Verily, it is We who have created man out of a drop of sperm intermingled, so that We might try him [in his later life]: and therefore We made him a being endowed with hearing and sight.

ayahs.arabic_text: إِنَّا هَدَيْنَٰهُ ٱلسَّبِيلَ إِمَّا شَاكِرًۭا وَإِمَّا كَفُورًا
ayahs.english_translation: Verily, We have shown him the way: [and it rests with him to prove himself] either grateful or ungrateful.

ayahs.arabic_text: إِنَّآ أَعْتَدْنَا لِلْكَٰفِرِينَ سَلَٰسِلَا۟ وَأَغْلَٰلًۭا وَسَعِيرًا
ayahs.english_translation: [Now,] behold, for those who deny the truth We have readied chains and shackles, and a blazing flame

ayahs.arabic_text: إِنَّ ٱلْأَبْرَارَ يَشْرَبُونَ مِن كَأْسٍۢ كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا كَافُورًا
ayahs.english_translation: [whereas,] behold, the truly virtuous shall drink from a cup flavoured with the calyx of sweet-smelling flowers:

ayahs.arabic_text: عَيْنًۭا يَشْرَبُ بِهَا عِبَادُ ٱللَّهِ يُفَجِّرُونَهَا تَفْجِيرًۭا
ayahs.english_translation: a source [of bliss] whereof God's servants shall drink, seeing it flow in a flow abundant.

ayahs.arabic_text: يُوفُونَ بِٱلنَّذْرِ وَيَخَافُونَ يَوْمًۭا كَانَ شَرُّهُۥ مُسْتَطِيرًۭا
ayahs.english_translation: [The truly virtuous are] they [who] fulfil their vows, and stand in awe of a Day the woe of which is bound to spread far and wide,

ayahs.arabic_text: وَيُطْعِمُونَ ٱلطَّعَامَ عَلَىٰ حُبِّهِۦ مِسْكِينًۭا وَيَتِيمًۭا وَأَسِيرًا
ayahs.english_translation: and who give food - however great be their own want of it - unto the needy, and the orphan, and the captive,

ayahs.arabic_text: إِنَّمَا نُطْعِمُكُمْ لِوَجْهِ ٱللَّهِ لَا نُرِيدُ مِنكُمْ جَزَآءًۭ وَلَا شُكُورًا
ayahs.english_translation: [saying, in their hearts,] "We feed you for the sake of God alone: we desire no recompense from you, nor thanks:

ayahs.arabic_text: إِنَّا نَخَافُ مِن رَّبِّنَا يَوْمًا عَبُوسًۭا قَمْطَرِيرًۭا
ayahs.english_translation: behold, we stand in awe of our Sustainer's judgment on a distressful, fateful Day!"

ayahs.arabic_text: فَوَقَىٰهُمُ ٱللَّهُ شَرَّ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمِ وَلَقَّىٰهُمْ نَضْرَةًۭ وَسُرُورًۭا
ayahs.english_translation: And so, God will preserve them from the woes of that Day, and will bestow on them brightness and joy,

ayahs.arabic_text: وَجَزَىٰهُم بِمَا صَبَرُوا۟ جَنَّةًۭ وَحَرِيرًۭا
ayahs.english_translation: and will reward them for all their patience in adversity with a garden [of bliss] and with [garments of] silk.

ayahs.arabic_text: مُّتَّكِـِٔينَ فِيهَا عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ ۖ لَا يَرَوْنَ فِيهَا شَمْسًۭا وَلَا زَمْهَرِيرًۭا
ayahs.english_translation: In that [garden] they will on couches recline, and will know therein neither [burning] sun nor cold severe,

ayahs.arabic_text: وَدَانِيَةً عَلَيْهِمْ ظِلَٰلُهَا وَذُلِّلَتْ قُطُوفُهَا تَذْلِيلًۭا
ayahs.english_translation: since its [blissful] shades will come down low over them, and low will hang down its clusters of fruit, most easy to reach.

ayahs.arabic_text: وَيُطَافُ عَلَيْهِم بِـَٔانِيَةٍۢ مِّن فِضَّةٍۢ وَأَكْوَابٍۢ كَانَتْ قَوَارِيرَا۠
ayahs.english_translation: And they will be waited upon with vessels of silver and goblets that will [seem to] be crystal –

ayahs.arabic_text: قَوَارِيرَا۟ مِن فِضَّةٍۢ قَدَّرُوهَا تَقْدِيرًۭا
ayahs.english_translation: crystal-like, [but] of silver - the measure whereof they alone will determine.

ayahs.arabic_text: وَيُسْقَوْنَ فِيهَا كَأْسًۭا كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا زَنجَبِيلًا
ayahs.english_translation: And in that [paradise] they will be given to drink of a cup flavoured with ginger,

ayahs.arabic_text: عَيْنًۭا فِيهَا تُسَمَّىٰ سَلْسَبِيلًۭا
ayahs.english_translation: [derived from] a source [to be found] therein, whose name is "Seek Thy Way".

ayahs.arabic_text: ۞ وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ وِلْدَٰنٌۭ مُّخَلَّدُونَ إِذَا رَأَيْتَهُمْ حَسِبْتَهُمْ لُؤْلُؤًۭا مَّنثُورًۭا
ayahs.english_translation: And immortal youths will wait upon them: when thou seest them, thou wouldst deem them to be scattered pearls;

ayahs.arabic_text: وَإِذَا رَأَيْتَ ثَمَّ رَأَيْتَ نَعِيمًۭا وَمُلْكًۭا كَبِيرًا
ayahs.english_translation: and when thou seest [anything that is] there thou wilt see [only] bliss and a realm transcendent

ayahs.arabic_text: عَٰلِيَهُمْ ثِيَابُ سُندُسٍ خُضْرٌۭ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٌۭ ۖ وَحُلُّوٓا۟ أَسَاوِرَ مِن فِضَّةٍۢ وَسَقَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ شَرَابًۭا طَهُورًا
ayahs.english_translation: Upon those [blest] will be garments of green silk and brocade; and they will be adorned with bracelets of silver. And their Sustainer will them to drink of a drink most pure.

ayahs.arabic_text: إِنَّ هَٰذَا كَانَ لَكُمْ جَزَآءًۭ وَكَانَ سَعْيُكُم مَّشْكُورًا
ayahs.english_translation: [And they will be told:] "Verily, all this is your reward since Your endeavour [in life] has met [God's] goodly acceptance!"

ayahs.arabic_text: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ تَنزِيلًۭا
ayahs.english_translation: VERILY, [O believer,] it is We who have bestowed from on high this Qur’an upon thee, step by step - truly a bestowal from on high!

ayahs.arabic_text: فَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تُطِعْ مِنْهُمْ ءَاثِمًا أَوْ كَفُورًۭا
ayahs.english_translation: Await, then, in all patience thy Sustainer's judgment, and pay no heed to any of them, who is a wilful sinner or an ingrate;

ayahs.arabic_text: وَٱذْكُرِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ بُكْرَةًۭ وَأَصِيلًۭا
ayahs.english_translation: and bear in mind thy Sustainer's name at morn and evening

ayahs.arabic_text: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَٱسْجُدْ لَهُۥ وَسَبِّحْهُ لَيْلًۭا طَوِيلًا
ayahs.english_translation: and during some of the night, and prostrate thyself before Him, and extol His limitless glory throughout the long night.

ayahs.arabic_text: إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ يُحِبُّونَ ٱلْعَاجِلَةَ وَيَذَرُونَ وَرَآءَهُمْ يَوْمًۭا ثَقِيلًۭا
ayahs.english_translation: Behold, they [who are unmindful of God] love this fleeting life, and leave behind them [all thought of] a grief-laden Day.

ayahs.arabic_text: نَّحْنُ خَلَقْنَٰهُمْ وَشَدَدْنَآ أَسْرَهُمْ ۖ وَإِذَا شِئْنَا بَدَّلْنَآ أَمْثَٰلَهُمْ تَبْدِيلًا
ayahs.english_translation: [They will not admit to themselves that] it We who have created them and strengthened their make - and [that] if it be Our will We can replace them entirely with others of their kind.

ayahs.arabic_text: إِنَّ هَٰذِهِۦ تَذْكِرَةٌۭ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلًۭا
ayahs.english_translation: VERILY, all this is an admonition: whoever, then, so wills, may unto his Sustainer find a way.

ayahs.arabic_text: وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمًۭا
ayahs.english_translation: But you cannot will it unless God wills [to show you that way]: for, behold, God is indeed all-seeing, wise.

ayahs.arabic_text: يُدْخِلُ مَن يَشَآءُ فِى رَحْمَتِهِۦ ۚ وَٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ أَعَدَّ لَهُمْ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًۢا
ayahs.english_translation: He admits unto His grace everyone who wills [to be admitted]; but as for the evildoers - for them has He readied grievous suffering [in the life to come].
